visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman sits in a modern office chair, her back to the camera as she looks at two large computer monitors displaying clinical data or skin analysis. She is dressed in a professional white collared shirt layered with a beige knit vest. The room is brightly lit, featuring white walls and minimalist decor. Large text overlays in pink and white appear on the screen, emphasizing the message about taking a rest. (2) The scene cuts to a well-lit clinical consultation room with light-colored curtains in the background. A female clinician in a dark professional suit is talking to a female client. The clinician gestures with her hands as she explains a concept, maintaining eye contact. The client listens attentively. This phase focuses on the interaction and the professional setting of a dermatology clinic. (3) A brief b-roll shot shows three individuals—one man and two women—walking away from the camera along a coastline towards the ocean. The sky is overcast and grey. They are dressed in casual summer wear, including yellow shorts and striped tops. This visual transition represents social activities like outings or interviews mentioned in the dialogue, contrasting with the clinical environment. (4) The video returns to the woman in the office chair. A circular close-up graphic of skin affected by acne and pustules is superimposed over the center of the frame to illustrate the dermatological condition being discussed. Later, dynamic comic-style motion lines and sparkling gold confetti graphics are added to the frame as the clinician discusses the improvements in skin texture and the effectiveness of treatments. (5) A final static title card appears on a clean white background with grey patterns. It displays the clinic's logo "DRX", social media handles, telephone numbers, and addresses for locations in Sanchong and Taipei. The text is neatly arranged in Traditional Chinese and English, serving as a clear call to action for viewers to contact the clinic.
